paragraph_text: (GA3) (A.Miasnikov)  Let  G  be a group acting freely on a  \Lambda-tree. Given any finite set of non-trivial elements of  G \ast G,   is there  a homomorphism of   G \ast G   into  G   such that the images of the given elements are also non-trivial?
